contract.intended_consumer: Brian and coding agents using the shared correction-learning gate
contract.outcome: A representative privacy-reduced native corpus establishes whether the correction classifier generalizes well enough for observe-mode adoption and independent signoff.

canonical_journey.starting_state: The frozen synthetic pilot passed its thresholds but independent signoff rejected promotion because no representative native held-out corpus exists.
canonical_journey.input: Authentically sampled Codex and Claude Code adjacent assistant-user exchanges with provenance and privacy reduction.
canonical_journey.action: Freeze labels before replay, run the existing structured classifier within its budget, inspect exact verdicts and traces, and obtain independent signoff.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Every sampled case has replayable provenance and a verdict; the decision either authorizes observe-only wiring or retains manual-off with exact failing evidence.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: Cases are hand-authored, selected after seeing verdicts, lack native provenance, exceed the authorized budget, or are promoted without independent signoff.
